description: Lists every 3D asset the project needs -- characters, props, environment pieces -- with what exists, what is placeholder, and the poly and texture budget each one has to fit.
when_to_use: the request is 'what models do we still need'
levels are standing on placeholder geometry
a model generation run needs a list to work from
avoid_when: the list already exists and the request is to produce the models
inputs: the art bible when there is one
outputs: model checklist with budgets and gaps marked
